annotations.title: Take something out of the setup

description: Takes out what was added by mistake: products or rivals by name, pictures or logos by file id, fonts by role, social accounts by address, guides by id, and files by id (a file of this project you added and no longer use, such as an earlier logo or font you replaced; only while the setup is open, in a project this setup made). A file taken out leaves the project's files too (as Brand's remove does), and so does a logo or font a new one replaces; nothing the owner added is touched.

files.description: File ids (get_setup's files) of this project you added and no longer use.

fonts.description: Fonts to take out, by role.

guides.description: Guides to take out, by id (get_setup).

logos.description: Logos to take out, by file id.

pictures.description: Pictures to take out, by file id.

products.description: Products to take out, by name.
